info.title: memoria-qmd
info.description: REST sidecar over the QMD SDK. Runs on the host that holds the models and index.sqlite; Memoria.Api is its only intended caller. Every route except /health and /openapi.json requires `Authorization: Bearer <shared secret>`.

DocumentMetadata.description: Fields lifted from the document's YAML frontmatter. Null when the document has none.

docsPending.description: Documents this run could not finish, including any it set aside. The job does not report success.

docsDeadLettered.description: Of those, how many were set aside for good. Later jobs skip them until a retry is due: see `GET /queue/dead-letters`.

attempts.description: How many times this job has started.

worker.description: Workers that embedded for the latest attempt, comma-separated.

docid.description: Six-character content id. Accepted anywhere a document reference is.

path.description: Path relative to the collection root.

fromLine.description: First line included in `body` (1-indexed) when a range was requested.

get.description: The process is up. Unauthenticated; does not touch the index or the models.

The index is open and the sidecar can serve. `models.resident` reports whether the embedding, reranking and expansion models are loaded; with `requireModels=true` the route returns 503 until they are.

status.description: `degraded`: remote LLM mode with some model role no worker can serve, or a job waiting to try again: see `jobs.stuck`.

unavailable.description: Roles no worker can serve right now. `documents` means document embedding is out while query vectors still work.

embedDisagreement.description: Workers that embedded the same text differently. Reported only: nothing acts on it. Empty until two workers have been compared.

documentsSetAside.description: Documents out of vector search because a worker refused them. Retried by themselves within a day, or at once by `POST /queue/dead-letters:clear`.

resident.description: True once every model is loaded in memory.

persistent.description: False means jobs are in memory only and would not survive a restart.

stuck.description: A job waiting to try again, and why. It retries by itself, for as long as it takes.

status.description: `degraded`: remote LLM mode with some model role no worker can serve, or a job waiting to try again: see `jobs.stuck`.

unavailable.description: Roles no worker can serve right now. `documents` means document embedding is out while query vectors still work.

embedDisagreement.description: Workers that embedded the same text differently. Reported only: nothing acts on it. Empty until two workers have been compared.

documentsSetAside.description: Documents out of vector search because a worker refused them. Retried by themselves within a day, or at once by `POST /queue/dead-letters:clear`.

resident.description: True once every model is loaded in memory.

persistent.description: False means jobs are in memory only and would not survive a restart.

stuck.description: A job waiting to try again, and why. It retries by itself, for as long as it takes.

get.description: QMD's own index status: document counts, embedding backlog, and per-collection stats.

needsEmbedding.description: Documents waiting to embed. Those set aside are counted in `documentsSetAside` instead.

documentsSetAside.description: Documents a job will not try again until a retry is due: see `GET /queue/dead-letters`.

post.description: Run QMD's hybrid pipeline (BM25 + vectors, RRF fusion, optional LLM rerank). Provide either `query` (auto-expanded into lex/vec/hyde variants by the local expansion model) or `searches` (typed sub-queries you compose yourself; the first gets 2x weight). `filters` are applied after retrieval on frontmatter, so a filtered call fetches extra candidates and may return fewer than `limit`.

searches.description: Typed sub-queries. lex → BM25, vec → embedding similarity, hyde → hypothetical document embedded.

intent.description: Background context that steers reranking and snippet selection. Does not search on its own.

filters.description: Frontmatter filters, applied after retrieval. Documents without frontmatter never match an active filter.

project.description: `project` frontmatter key; any-of when a list. Case-insensitive.

branch.description: `git_branch` frontmatter key; any-of when a list. Case-insensitive.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound on start_time (or date): YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp.

until.description: Inclusive upper bound; a bare date covers the whole day.

tags.description: Every listed tag must be present. Case-insensitive.

candidateLimit.description: Candidates passed to the reranker (QMD default 40).

rerank.description: false skips the LLM reranker for sub-second lex+vec fusion.

line.description: 1-indexed line of the best-matching chunk; pass to /docs/{id}:line to read around it.

degraded.description: True when this search ran without something a full search uses. Results are valid but may rank worse.

degradedReasons.description: What it went without. With `no_rerank`, scores are rank-derived rather than reranker scores, and `minScore` was not applied.

filtered.description: True when frontmatter filters were applied.

fetched.description: Candidates retrieved from QMD before filtering.

get.description: Fetch one document by display path (`collection/path.md`), `qmd://` URI, or docid (`abc123` or `%23abc123`). A line-range suffix narrows the body: `path.md:100` from line 100, `path.md:100:40` for 40 lines from line 100. Explicit `fromLine`/`maxLines` query parameters take precedence over the suffix.

parameters.name: collections
parameters.description: Resolve the reference only inside these collections. Anything else is a plain miss, with no similar-files scan and no read.

parameters.name: similarFiles
parameters.description: false resolves the reference without QMD's scan of every path on a miss, and returns no suggestions. Memoria.Api always sends false.

post.description: Batch fetch by glob (`claude-sessions/2026-05*.md`), by a list of references (paths or docids), or both. Each selector resolves on its own and the results merge, one entry per file; a selector that matches nothing adds a line to `errors` without failing the others. Documents larger than `maxBytes` are listed under `skipped` rather than returned. A glob may use only `*`, `?` and whole-segment `**`; braces, brackets and extglobs are refused, because QMD's matcher can be made to run indefinitely.

pattern.description: Glob, comma-separated references, or a comma-separated mix of both.

collections.description: Match and read only inside these collections. An empty list means nothing, not everything.

maxTotalBytes.description: Budget for all bodies in this response. Documents that would pass it are listed under `skipped` and are not read.

similarFiles.description: false resolves the reference without QMD's scan of every path on a miss, and returns no suggestions. Memoria.Api always sends false.

maxLines.description: Truncate each body to this many lines.

truncated.description: Globs matched more documents than one request may select; the rest were not looked at.

post.description: Write markdown into a collection's directory on the sidecar host and queue an index update for that collection. The file on disk is the durable artifact; the index is rebuilt from it. Returns 202 with the job that will make the document searchable. The job is debounced: a burst of documents for one collection shares a single job, which stays `queued` until writes go quiet. Redaction is the caller's responsibility and must happen before this call.

path.description: Relative to the collection root; must match the collection's glob.

overwrite.description: false returns 409 when the path already exists.

delete.description: Remove a document's file from its collection's directory and queue an index update. Only safety checks apply, unlike `POST /documents`: a file outside the collection's glob or under an ignore rule can still be removed. The path must stay inside the root, cross no link, have no dot-prefixed segment, and match the entry's exact name, so a case alias returns 409. Idempotent: a path with no file returns 202 with `deleted: false` and still queues the update, so a delete that was interrupted before reindexing can be retried. The document stays searchable until the index is updated. The returned job is debounced like an ingest; when that wait matters, `POST /reindex` for the collection updates the index without it.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative to the collection root. Need not match the collection's glob.

deleted.description: False when no file existed at the path.

get.description: Every collection in the index with its document count and root context.

path.description: Collection root on the sidecar host.

totalDocuments.description: Including inactive rows kept for history.

post.description: Rescan the collections' directories (`qmd update`) and, by default, embed what changed (`qmd embed`). Jobs run one at a time behind a single worker; an identical job already waiting is returned instead of duplicated, and starts as soon as the worker is free even if it was waiting on the document debounce.

force.description: Re-embed every document, not only changed ones. Expensive.

get.description: Most recent first. The sidecar keeps the last 100 in memory; history does not survive a restart.

Reindex jobs by state, model calls by priority class, and calls per worker. Jobs persist across restarts in their own database beside the index. Model call figures are live and are empty in local LLM mode.

deadLetters.description: Documents set aside because no worker could embed them. See `GET /queue/dead-letters`.

persistence.description: Whether jobs would survive a restart. `healthy: false` means the queue is carrying on in memory.

held.description: The queued jobs waiting on the debounce or a retry delay.

queueDepth.description: As the worker last reported it.

get.description: Documents a worker definitely refused (400 or 413) while it could embed a known-good text. Later jobs skip them, so they are out of vector search, but can still be found lexically. They are tried again when their content or path changes, when the workers or model change, after 24 hours, by a force job, or when cleared.

post.description: Let every set-aside document embed again, and queue a job for it. For after a worker or model has been fixed.
Queue a failed job again under the same id. Returns 409 unless it has failed.

Stop a job that has not finished. A waiting job ends at once. A running one stops at its next safe point, so it may still read `running` in this response. A cancelled job reports `failed` with the error `Cancelled`. Returns 409 if it has already finished.

get.description: Each worker's state, last heartbeat, in-flight calls and error rate. Empty in local LLM mode. Never includes tokens.

circuit.description: The worst of `circuits`, over the roles this worker is configured for.

circuits.description: `documents` is document embedding, kept apart from `embed`, which is query vectors.

embedDisagrees.description: This worker embedded the same text differently from another. Reported only: nothing acts on it.

embedModelCompatible.description: False keeps this worker off embedding and tokens. Null until checked.

errorRate.description: Failed share of the last 100 calls.

post.description: Drop every cached rerank score and query expansion. Replacing a worker already leaves its answers behind when its name, address or model files change, and they expire after a week; this is for a worker that gave bad answers and then came back unchanged.

get.description: The contract this process serves. Unauthenticated. The same document is committed as sidecar/openapi.json.
